title: UnSilk
description: A datapack that allows the conversion of Silk Touched items back into their 'raw' variants.
body:
# UnSilk
Silk Touch is handy, but a bit of a pest when you have to place stacks of ores just to break again with another pickaxe, wasting durability and time. UnSilk aims to solve this hassle.

## How it works
UnSilk is a datapack, meaning it can be installed per-world, and is completely server side. All it does is add a few Crafting Recipes. Place a Silk Touched item into a Stonecutter, and the option will appear to convert it to its 'raw' drop.
